# StoryForge v4.0.4 · 大型运行合同保存修复

## 修复范围

修复合法大型运行合同通过接纳后，保存或修订时被事件快照旧 100000 字符限制误拒绝的问题（#178、PR #185）。完整合同与 accepted/revised 快照使用统一的 32 MiB UTF-8 有限记录预算，与既有 durable checkpoint 的规模保护一致。超预算仍明确拒绝，不截断或省略证据；单字段、Skill、权限、作用域、stale 与模型预算不变。

保存、修订、刷新和完整备份导入继续使用原有运行账本；无新表、迁移或作品 owner 变化。此修复不追溯补造旧失败运行，也不自动重发模型请求。v4.0.3 尚不包含该修复。

## 下载与升级

选择 Windows EXE、Mac Apple Silicon/Intel DMG、Android APK 或对应平台便携 ZIP，并核对 SHA256SUMS.txt。升级前保存编辑、结束生成并在原环境导出完整 JSON 备份。覆盖安装保留应用数据；Mac 替换应用。切换存储环境时显式导出/导入，不卸载或清空原数据。Windows 尚无发布者证书，Mac 使用 ad-hoc 签名且未 Apple 公证，iOS 暂缓。

发行沿用正式 v4.0.3 的覆盖升级基线及完整 CI、浏览器、客户端、便携启动和正式签名 Android 四阶段验证。实际发布时间与可下载附件以本 Release 状态为准；尚未确认的其他问题继续在各自 Issue 跟进。

## English

Fixes valid large run contracts being rejected by a smaller accepted/revised event-snapshot limit after acceptance. Contracts and their full event snapshots now share a finite 32 MiB UTF-8 record budget, consistent with the existing durable checkpoint envelope. Oversized records still fail explicitly. Field, Skill, permission, scope, freshness and model-call budgets remain unchanged; snapshots are never truncated.

Saving, revision, reload and complete-backup restoration use the existing ledger, with no new tables, migration or ownership changes. Failed historical runs are not fabricated or silently retried. Export a complete backup before updating, preserve application data, and verify SHA256SUMS.txt. This repair is not included in v4.0.3. Windows is unsigned; macOS uses ad-hoc signing without Apple notarization. Other unconfirmed reports remain open.
